source_quote: Suites are separated from each other and from the common corridor by fire separations with a fire-resistance rating of 30 min.
Smoke alarms are installed in every dwelling unit.
Each dwelling unit has one smoke alarm, mounted on the living room ceiling; there are no smoke alarms in the bedrooms.
Walls between dwelling units are built to an STC rating of 45.
The two common exit stairs are 1 100 mm wide.
Risers on the common exit stairs are 190 mm high.
Handrails on the common exit stairs are mounted 900 mm above the stair nosings.
Balconies on the second and third storeys, about 3 m and 6 m above finished ground level, have glass guards 900 mm high.
The building is not sprinklered; each floor area has two exits, and the travel distance to the nearest exit is up to 38 m.
Ground-floor units are two-storey townhouse-style units with bedrooms on the upper level and their only egress door on the lower level, opening directly to the outside.
